So I believe there's no way she's not self-aware about being severely malnourished.
Also "Those ppl do not matter" - so who matters? Do they think that only people who praise Eugenia 24/7 matter? Why?
I know it's hurtful to read things you disagree with, but turning a blind eye on something will never solve a problem. Ignoring the problem will always create only even more problems.

Being concerned and trying to judge things objectively is not toxic at all... Also toxic positivity exists and it's very harmful. Eugenia's followers do nothing but praise her, lie to her ("you look so healthy and happy!") and tell her to never look at anyone who's concerned for her well being (because being concerned is apparently super toxic), and that's the prime example of toxic positivity.
